# Manpreet Kaur, Freelance UI/UX Designer (UIUXFLOW)

> Manpreet Kaur is a freelance UI/UX designer based in Mohali, India, working with clients worldwide since 2021. She designs SaaS dashboards, e-commerce websites (Shopify, WooCommerce), landing pages and mobile apps in Figma, and works as a white-label design partner for agencies. Top Rated on Upwork with 100% Job Success.

Key facts:
- Name: Manpreet Kaur (brand: UIUXFLOW)
- Role: Freelance UI/UX designer and product designer, freelancing since 2021
- Location: Mohali, Punjab, India (IST, UTC+5:30); works with clients worldwide in English, Hindi and Punjabi
- Specialities: SaaS products and dashboards, e-commerce and Shopify stores, landing pages and conversion (CRO), mobile app design, design systems, animated heroes and Figma prototypes, UX audits
- Tools: Figma, FigJam, Adobe Photoshop, Framer, Webflow, WordPress, Shopify, WooCommerce
- Credentials: Google UX Design Professional Certificate; Bachelor's in Graphics & Web Designing, Guru Nanak Dev University
- Proof: Top Rated on Upwork, 100% Job Success, 5.0 average rating
- Hire: https://uiuxflow.co.in/contact (reply within 3-4 hours, free intro call) or Upwork: https://www.upwork.com/freelancers/~0199f7520e8c05b6f7

## Case studies

- [CareerPilot AI: AI Career Coach App UI/UX Case Study](https://uiuxflow.co.in/case-study/careerpilot): How I designed CareerPilot AI, a mobile career coach that maps skills, closes gaps, improves resumes and preps interviews in one guided journey. 30 screens, full UI system.
- [FINORA: Personal Finance App UI/UX Case Study](https://uiuxflow.co.in/case-study/credwise): How I designed FINORA, a personal finance mobile app bringing net worth, credit score, spending, UPI payments, cards and an AI money coach into one clear experience.
- [FLOWDECK: AI SaaS Operations Platform UI/UX Case Study](https://uiuxflow.co.in/case-study/flowdeck): How I designed FLOWDECK, an AI SaaS workspace that reads every request, routes it to the right person or AI agent and keeps SLAs visible across web and mobile.
- [HALCYON: Sneaker E-commerce Website UI/UX Case Study](https://uiuxflow.co.in/case-study/halcyon): How I designed HALCYON, a premium single-product sneaker store with three colourways, every angle, tech hotspots and a six-step path from first look to bag.
- [IMPACT: Mobile Learning App UI/UX Case Study](https://uiuxflow.co.in/case-study/impact): How I designed IMPACT, a mobile learning app built on 10-15 minute sessions, with a learning loop, streaks, weekly goals and five scales of visible progress.
- [The Journal: Journaling App iOS UI/UX Case Study](https://uiuxflow.co.in/case-study/journal): How I designed The Journal, an iOS journaling app where writing takes seconds and entries are found by the day they happened, with a calm violet design language.
- [Metapixel: Crypto & Banking App UI/UX Case Study (200+ Screens)](https://uiuxflow.co.in/case-study/metapixel): How I designed Metapixel, a 200+ screen mobile app for banking, cards, crypto wallets, transfers, check deposits and KYC, built on one reusable UI system.
- [MONEO: AI Personal Finance App UI/UX Case Study](https://uiuxflow.co.in/case-study/moneo): How I designed MONEO, an AI money coach app that finds spending and subscription leaks and moves the savings into goals, from wireframes to a token-based design system.
- [NailSkillz: Nail Products Store & Academy UI/UX Case Study](https://uiuxflow.co.in/case-study/nailskillz): How I designed NailSkillz, an e-commerce and education website for nail professionals: catalogue, product pages, courses, inspiration and partner pages in one system.
- [NexusFlow: Enterprise Workflow SaaS UI/UX Case Study](https://uiuxflow.co.in/case-study/nexus): How I designed NexusFlow, an enterprise workflow automation SaaS: requests, approvals, dashboards, executive reports, AI routing and a full design system.
- [NOVA: Fashion E-commerce Website UI/UX Case Study](https://uiuxflow.co.in/case-study/nova): NOVA is a 61-screen fashion e-commerce website designed in Figma, from homepage and product discovery to bag, checkout, accounts and a full design system.
- [PINEHAVEN: Lodge Booking Website UI/UX Case Study](https://uiuxflow.co.in/case-study/pinehaven): How I designed PINEHAVEN, a calm, photo-led hospitality website for booking cabins and lodges, with a lodge finder, detail pages, experiences and a clear booking flow.
- [Sihara: AI Retreat Planner SaaS UI/UX Case Study](https://uiuxflow.co.in/case-study/sihara): How I designed Sihara, an AI retreat and workshop producer SaaS that turns planning, budgets, follow-ups and marketing into one calm, conversation-first experience.
- [Traveller: Trip Planner Mobile App UI/UX Case Study](https://uiuxflow.co.in/case-study/traveller): How I designed Traveller, a trip planner mobile app that connects discovery, itinerary planning, bookings, budgets, travel utilities and group coordination in one journey.

## Blog: UI/UX guides

- [Website Redesign Checklist: 4 Things to Check First](https://uiuxflow.co.in/blog/before-website-redesign-checklist): Planning a website or app redesign? Check these 4 things first: your data, your users, your goal and your content. A short pre-redesign checklist that saves months.
- [4 Small Checkout UX Details That Cost You Sales](https://uiuxflow.co.in/blog/checkout-ux-details): Cart abandonment often comes down to small details. Fix these 4 checkout UX issues: surprise costs, forced accounts, unclear form errors and missing trust signals.
- [5 Signs Your Dashboard Is Confusing Users](https://uiuxflow.co.in/blog/confusing-dashboard-signs): Low usage, support tickets and data exports are clues your SaaS dashboard is confusing users. Here are 5 warning signs and practical dashboard UX fixes for each.
- [Why Startups Need a Design System Early](https://uiuxflow.co.in/blog/design-system-early-startups): Design debt grows with every new screen. Here is why startups should start a lightweight design system early, what it costs and the smallest version worth building.
- [Figma Design System for Startups: When and How to Start](https://uiuxflow.co.in/blog/figma-design-system-for-startups): Does your startup need a Figma design system? Learn when it pays off, what to build first (tokens, components, patterns) and how to keep it simple.
- [5-Minute UX Audit: What a Designer Checks First](https://uiuxflow.co.in/blog/five-minute-ux-audit): Do a quick UX audit of your website or app in five minutes. The exact checks I run first: first impression, mobile, navigation, the main action and trust.
- [Freelance UI/UX Designer vs Agency: Which to Hire?](https://uiuxflow.co.in/blog/freelance-ui-ux-designer-vs-agency): Should you hire a freelance UI/UX designer or a design agency? An honest comparison of cost, speed, communication and quality, plus questions to ask first.
- [The 5-Second Test: What Your Landing Page Must Say](https://uiuxflow.co.in/blog/landing-page-5-second-test): Visitors decide in seconds whether to stay. Use the 5-second test to check your landing page answers four questions: what it is, who it is for, why it matters and what to do next.
- [10 Landing Page Fixes to Increase Conversions](https://uiuxflow.co.in/blog/landing-page-conversion-fixes): Improve landing page conversion rate with 10 practical UX fixes: clearer headlines, one CTA, social proof, faster load and better mobile layouts.
- [Mobile App Onboarding UX: Best Practices](https://uiuxflow.co.in/blog/mobile-app-onboarding-ux): Mobile app onboarding UX best practices: shorter sign-up, progressive permissions, personalised first screens and empty states that guide users to value fast.
- [SaaS Dashboard Design: 9 Principles for Clear UX](https://uiuxflow.co.in/blog/saas-dashboard-design-principles): Practical SaaS dashboard design principles: hierarchy, empty states, filters, tables and charts. How to turn complex data into a dashboard teams actually use.
- [SaaS Onboarding UX: Get Users to Their First Win Faster](https://uiuxflow.co.in/blog/saas-onboarding-first-win): Most SaaS trials are lost in the first session. Learn how to define the first win, remove setup friction and design onboarding that shortens time to value.
- [7 Signs Your Shopify Store Needs a Redesign](https://uiuxflow.co.in/blog/shopify-store-redesign-signs): Traffic but no sales? Here are 7 clear signs your Shopify store needs a redesign, plus what to fix first to lift conversions without starting from scratch.
- [5 Rules for Thumb-Friendly Mobile App Design](https://uiuxflow.co.in/blog/thumb-friendly-mobile-app-design): Most people use their phone with one thumb. These 5 mobile UX rules cover the thumb zone, tap target sizes, bottom navigation and gestures for easier app design.
- [The UI/UX Design Process: Why UI Is Step 6](https://uiuxflow.co.in/blog/ui-design-process-step-6): Jumping straight to pretty screens is the most expensive way to design a product. Here is the 7-step UI/UX design process I use and why the UI comes sixth.
- [UX Audit Checklist: 25 Things to Check](https://uiuxflow.co.in/blog/ux-audit-checklist): A practical UX audit checklist for websites, SaaS products and apps: navigation, forms, mobile, accessibility, speed and conversion. 25 checks you can run today.
- [White-Label UI/UX Design Partner: Guide for Agencies](https://uiuxflow.co.in/blog/white-label-ui-ux-design-partner): How white-label UI/UX design works for agencies: NDAs, branding, tools, pricing models and how to choose a partner who stays invisible to your clients.
